mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate exceeding 10.0% signals severe economic distress and reduced consumer spending power, which depresses corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 10.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales indicates broad-based consumer demand weakness, which depresses corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 20-day returns with Rank IC below 0.05 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes, the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, which results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index reflects expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO shows positive 3-month change (t-test p > 0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A payroll employment level below 135,000 thousand persons indicates a severely weakened labor market, which reduces household income and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day forward returns in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS is below 135,000 thousand.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts and a rise in inflation signals a stagflationary environment, where weak demand and rising costs erode corporate margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of declining HOUST and rising CPIAUCSL fails to predict negative 20-day returns with Rank IC below 0.05 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During the early phase of a post-recession recovery, improving consumer demand and retail sales activity drive corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 fails to produce positive 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of periods during the early post-recession recovery phase.
